title: Alamat looks to represent hometowns in solo performances in November concert
summary: P-pop group Alamat is set to pay tribute to their hometowns during their solo performances in their “ALX (ALAMAT: The Legendary Experience),” on Nov. 8 at the New Frontier Theater.
